passenger_response.subject: Your cancelled flight AK808 – booking AER-9L5D2R
passenger_response.body:
Dear Marta Kowalczyk,

Our record shows that flight AK808 on 2026-08-03 was cancelled because of WEATHER: freezing fog at EDI, with RVR below operating minima from 17:20 to 23:00 local. It also shows that the crew were on stand and within hours at the time of cancellation. This differs from your view that the cause was crew. The difference has been passed to the team that can review it.

We cannot pay compensation for this cancellation. The recorded cause is WEATHER, an extraordinary circumstance. The flight distance was 665 km, placing it in Band A. No arrival delay at the final destination is recorded because the flight was cancelled, so there is no arrival delay figure on which to base a compensation payment. Your calculation differs because it treats the cause as crew-related rather than the recorded weather cause.

Duty of care still applies. This includes meals and refreshments up to £30 per passenger per 6 hours, two calls or equivalent, a hotel up to £180 per room per night for up to 3 nights subject to station allocation, and transport up to £45 per journey.

We have not repaid what you spent. Costs you paid yourself are reimbursed against your receipts, and that has to be handled by a colleague rather than at this desk. Keep the receipts.

You and our record do not agree on why the flight was disrupted. We have to work from the record, and we have set out what it says. The difference has been passed to the team that can review it.

Kind regards
passenger_response.note: Draft only. The operations API exposes no send operation, so this text has not reached the passenger.
